victoryMessage: The kingdom of Lombardy now dominates all of Italy. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Lombardy is nominally under the rule of the Holy Roman Empire, but the great cities of Milan and Genoa have begun to assert their independence. If they were to seize all of Italy, their freedom from imperial control would be assured.

victoryMessage: The Normans now dominate all of Italy. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Normans first came into Italy to fight as mercenaries against Saracen raiders. But on seeing the weakness of the local rulers, they set out in force and captured several cities for themselves. Can anyone now stop these fierce Northmen?

victoryMessage: The Papal State now dominate all of Italy. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Papal States are the dominion of the Vicar of Christ, surely entrusted in his care by God himself. And why should God not wish for his domain to spread throughout Italy? The lives lost would clearly be but a token before such glory!

victoryMessage: The Arabs now dominate all of Italy. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Arab Kalbid dynasty has ruled over Sicily for a hundred years, and cities throughout Italy fear their frequent raids. A strong ruler could go much further still, subjugating all the squabbling Christian kingdoms under his heel.

victoryMessage: The Byzantine Empire now dominates all of Italy. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Italy is the heart of the old Roman Empire, and without doubt belongs to the true heirs of Rome, the Byzantines. For centuries they've held the south, waiting for an opportunity to retake what is theirs. Now the time has come.
